[RESPONSE] I’ve been having upsetting dreams, flashbacks, and a lot of anxiety—these started about 7 weeks ago. Since returning from active duty in Iraq three months ago, I’ve been extremely jumpy, constantly on edge, and scared of loud noises—like they remind me of what I experienced there. I’ve been avoiding places that bring back memories, like the shooting range, and lately I’ve even been refusing to leave the house unless my wife persuades me. I also feel guilty about things that happened during deployment and have been struggling to sleep.
